provenance: Questions, translations and relevance labels were drafted by an AI assistant (Claude) from the document titles and text; NOT reviewed by a human. Labels list every document judged to answer the question (any counts as a hit); primary_document_id is the most specific one. The retrieval glossary in query_analysis.py was written by the same assistant, so results may be optimistic for glossary terms; treat as a pilot until a human reviews the labels.
latency_note: in-process (school server CPU, in-memory store): NOT the hosted latency
